//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder yönergesiyle istenen gözetimsiz inşa orkestratörünü (kalıcı kontrol durumu, kota otomasyonu, dar komut sözleşmeleri, review/remediation/merge/release/imza/Phase0 yürütücüleri, Task Scheduler kaydı) ve aynı commit'teki trust-root reseal'ini kaydeder; etkinleştirme bağımsız review CLEAN olduktan sonra yapılır, imza ssh-agent anahtarı tutana kadar bekler.
founderRequest: Implement and activate FULL UNATTENDED UASCO ORCHESTRATION: repository-native durable supervisor under Windows Task Scheduler (login, reboot, provider retry time, recoverable interruption), authoritative ORCHESTRATOR_STATE with atomic auditable transitions and no duplicate reviews after restart, complete Codex quota automation without consuming review/format/remediation retries and with FOUNDER_MANUAL_QUOTA_RESET support, automatic Claude -> Codex review loop with CLEAN integration and package-scoped remediation, narrow exact command contracts instead of blanket shell access, LOCAL_CLAUDE + CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION with AUTO routing and honest NOT_CONFIGURED cloud, release pipeline automation that never reuses an old signature, secure local unattended signing only through an OS-backed signer (otherwise WAITING_FOR_SECURE_SIGNER), GitHub checks without faking branch protection, Phase0 automation preserving failed attempts, dependency-aware lanes, no repeated Founder questions for approved policy, unattended end-to-end and adversarial tests, self-healing lock/lease/idempotency, separate bounded package, validation, commit, independent Codex review, activation after CLEAN.

founderAuthorization.rule: [Directive 2026-09-29] Implement this as a separate bounded autonomy-hardening package; commit it; send it through the existing independent Codex review loop; after CLEAN, activate the unattended supervisor; do not weaken the existing trust model; Task Scheduler / existing approved autostart mechanism for the supervisor; evidence-key ACL hardening and UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor Task Scheduler registration already approved; private signing key must never enter the repository, cloud, artifacts, logs or Claude/Codex, passphrase never stored in plaintext. [Permission 2026-09-29] İzni veriyorum. Ancak izin yalnızca bu autonomy-hardening paketinin repo içindeki dosyalarını ve önceden tanımlanmış exact command contracts kapsamını kapsasın. Şunlara blanket/genel izin VERME: arbitrary Bash / PowerShell / cmd, repo dışına yazma, credential export, signing private key erişimi, force push, trust/security policy weakening, bilinmeyen external network işlemleri. Paketi tamamla: kayıt betiği, senaryo/regression/adversarial testleri, dokümantasyon, reseal, commit, Codex independent review. Windows ssh-agent servisini Founder kendisi Administrator PowerShell'de etkinleştirir ve anahtarı kendisi ekler; bu tek sistem ayarı dışında paket devam eder.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

design.state: control section (2.0.0) validated on every write; transitions appended to a hash-chained JSONL log then written atomically; a tick refuses to run on a broken chain; process lock plus lease/heartbeat; in-flight markers recovered from stale workers.
design.engine: nextAction/applyOutcome are deterministic; dependencies and merge conditions gate eligibility; QUOTA blocks only the provider's actions and consumes no review cycle, format retry or remediation retry; BLOCKED -> remediation only with recorded authority and below the cycle limit, otherwise FOUNDER_DECISION_PENDING on that package only; transient errors back off (5 min doubling to 6 h) and escalate after 5 attempts; a reinstall over an accepted installation is a Founder decision.
design.executors: review adopts a completed run for the same bundle digest and cycle, runs the canonical broker otherwise, records environment-block.json on quota, evaluates with the ported supervisor-equivalent governance and records evidence; merge is fast-forward only after checking the CLEAN evidence and the tree; packaging adopts a complete release, otherwise exports, verifies, builds SHA256SUMS and a deterministic ZIP, verifies a fresh extract with validation and supersedes older releases without deleting; signing uses only ssh-agent with the public key and adopts valid signatures; Phase0 preserves the previous install as a failed attempt and reads the result only from PHASE0_ACCEPTANCE.json; builder rounds route through execution-routing, enforce scope and recorded protected authority, reseal when needed, validate twice and build the next frozen bundle.
design.contracts: fixed programs, typed parameters, paths only under policy roots, no shell, no deletion/force push/credential export contracts; env override only for repository node scripts (brokers need safeChildEnv).
design.portEquivalence: The ported review pipeline reproduced the manual tools on real data: the PKG-R2 run re-evaluated to the same review sha256 and effective review digest (CLEAN), the PKG-X1 bundle rebuilt identical except frozenAt/runId/digests, and the precheck passed on the real PKG-X1 review clone through the real contract runner.
design.cloud: claude --cloud is an official CLI option, but cloud sessions need the GitHub repository and autonomous pushes are not allowed while branch protection is unavailable; CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION stays NOT_CONFIGURED with the discovery recorded.
design.signer: Windows ssh-agent was DISABLED/STOPPED at implementation time; the Founder enables it and loads the key personally; until then releases wait in WAITING_FOR_SECURE_SIGNER while all other work continues.

reseal.runAfter: all protected edits of this commit, with no other untracked or ignored files under protected prefixes

validationEnvironment.measuredBy: the validation run itself (node/npm/git/PowerShell versions captured before the canonical runner)

validation.workspace: fresh clone of 1e3a123 mirroring the AUT1 working tree, reviewed lock installed, .ai/runtime cleared before the run; repository .ai/runtime untouched
validation.orchestratorSelftest: PASS 16/16 (e2e, quota, restart, duplicate worker, remediation, unknown command, cloud fallback, signing locality, CLEAN_LOCAL_ONLY honesty, signer wait, log tamper, manual quota reset, retry parsing, transient backoff, reinstall gate, guarded helpers)
validation.portEquivalenceSmoke: ported review pipeline reproduced PKG-R2 governed result (same review sha256 and effective digest) and PKG-X1 bundle (identical except timestamps); precheck passed on the real PKG-X1 clone
validation.rerunAfterCheckpointFinalized: canonical runner rerun on the final tree before commit
